Hi! Triaging older bugs this week — I think this one has shipped and can be closed.

The traceback you posted points at `event_based_path_watcher.py` lines 402 and 452, where `os.path.commonpath([path, abs_changed_path]) == path` raised `ValueError: Paths don't have the same drive` on Windows when an event referred to a file on a different drive than a watched directory.

That call site is now wrapped in `try/except ValueError` on `develop` and the different-drive case just continues the loop — see [`lib/streamlit/watcher/event_based_path_watcher.py:454-468`](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/develop/lib/streamlit/watcher/event_based_path_watcher.py#L454-L468). The fix landed in [#12741](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12741) (commit `a8e49a83d`, "Fix file watcher issue with common path check") on 2025-10-15, after this issue was filed.

If you can update past the release containing #12741 (1.50.x line and later) and still see the same `ValueError` traceback, please share the new full traceback (with the post-fix line numbers) — the protection is specifically for the `commonpath` ValueError, so any remaining occurrence would point at a different code path and would be worth tracking separately.

Otherwise this should be safe to close. Thanks!

(Disclosure: I drafted this comment with help from Claude Code while triaging stale issues; the references above were verified manually against the current `develop` branch.)
